create_functional_call: create a functional call on a PyTorch module by replacing its parameters and buffers with provided tensors
test_functional_call_tied_weights: test functional_call with tied weights to ensure shared parameters are updated together
build_vmap_ensemble: build a vmap-compatible ensemble by stacking parameters and buffers across multiple identical models
test_stack_module_state: test stack_module_state to verify all models share the same class and training mode before stacking
create_construct_stacked_leaf: create a stacked leaf tensor by stacking per-model tensors and making them optimizable leaf nodes
